page.overview:
Who is Andal's aide?

In 99 AG, the general's headquarters in Pebble Pond Village was visited by Suki's team of Kyoshi Warriors. As Andal gave the newcomers an audience, the aide provided her superior with tea and observed in silence. On the next day, the aide accompanied Andal as the general observed her troops assembling for an upcoming offensive. When Andal ordered the Kyoshi Warriors to take up Earth Kingdom Army equipment as they had joined her unit, the aide wrote down the general's order for the supply of new uniforms and weaponry to Suki's team.

The aide accompanied Andal to the frontline, and later noticed when Suki's team organized a unsanctioned raid against Yuze's outpost. She reported this to her superior, allowing Andal to exploit the Kyoshi Warriors' actions and achieve a victory over the Fire Army.

Andal's aide was quite stoic when on duty, taking her position very seriously.
